# 02 · Build fingerprint and API/data drift

*Generated by `tools/refpack/diff_builds.py` + `build_map_docs.py` on 2026-09-29. Compared: **K-copy (bot build)** = `K:\Downloads-IDM\Thronefall` (the copy the bot runs on) vs **Steam** = `C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Thronefall` (Steam appid 2239150, buildid 25306299, updated 2026-09-25 10:39 UTC).*

## 1. Fingerprints

|  | K-copy (bot build) | Steam |
|---|---|---|
| Game version (`PlayerSettings.bundleVersion`) | 2.13 | 2.14 |
| Unity | 2022.3.62f2 | 2022.3.62f2 |
| Assembly-CSharp SHA-256 | `F350269E…6B30` | `217DC7E6…DFE6` |
| Assembly-CSharp size | 2,587,648 B | 2,531,840 B |
| Managed DLLs (identical / changed) | 148 identical | 20 differ (rebuilt, mostly timestamps) |
| Game types (excl. vendor, compiler-generated) | 950 | 873 |
| Script objects decoded byte-exact | 655,330 / 655,330 (100.0%) | 655,157 / 655,157 (100.0%) |

The same extraction pipeline (layout generator → byte-exact verifier → data extractors) runs unchanged on **both** builds, which is the evidence that it will survive future updates: re-run `tools/refpack/run_all.ps1` after a game patch and read this report.

## 2. What changed in the code (2.13 → 2.14)

* **42 types added, 113 removed, 73 changed.** The removed set is dominated by DLC content that is not part of the base game (bosses such as Crystal Dragon / Lava Golem / Construct Colossus, `AutoAttackFlamethrower`, `AutoAttackRailgun`, trap towers, `EnergyCore*`, `Equippable.ContentPack`). Added: DLC-gate UI (`DlcGateUIFrameHelper`, `UIFrameManager.TryOpenDLCGate`), wardrobe/platform helpers, `TFUIHoldableButton`, `Thronefall.DLCServices.*`.
* **Base-game data is unchanged.** See §4.

**Breaking for the current Trainer:** `PlayerInteraction.SpendEnergyCores` (Harmony target), `EnergyCoreBalance`, `BuildSlot.NextUpgradeOrBuildEnergyCoreCost` and `TagManager.energyCores` no longer exist in 2.14 — code referencing them fails to compile or patch there. Everything else is additive or a body change. Guidance: keep developing against 2.13 (the K: copy) and gate energy-core code behind a build check.

## 4. Data drift (waves, stats, UI, controls)

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Scenes compared | 37 |
| Scenes with different wave/slot totals | [{"scene": "Wildbach MM3", "enemiesTotal": [1093, 1092], "baseHpTotal": [103480.0, 103430.0]}] |
| Enemy stat differences (HP, speed, attacks) | 0 |
| Balance-sheet entries changed | 0 of 3174 |
| UI frames only in 2.14 | DLC Gate Frame |
| UI frames only in 2.13 | none |
| Input actions only in 2.14 | NextTab, PrevTab, Wardrobe Rotate Left, Wardrobe Rotate Right |
| Input actions only in 2.13 | none |

**Conclusion:** the per-level handbook (waves, spawn lines, slots, unit and enemy stats) is valid for both builds; only Wildbach MM3 differs (1 enemy fewer, −50 base HP).

## 5. Re-running after a game update

```powershell
# 1) map the new DLLs (2.7 s):  dotnet tools\refpack\TfMap\bin\Release\net8.0\TfMap.dll <Managed dir> <out maps dir>
# 2) prove the layouts: python tools\refpack\verify_layouts.py --game <Thronefall_Data> --maps <out maps dir>
# 3) extract:            python tools\refpack\extract_levels.py / extract_meta.py / extract_navmesh.py / extract_terrain.py  (set TF_DATA/TF_MAPS/TF_OUT to target another install)
# 4) compare:            python tools\refpack\diff_builds.py --a-maps ... --b-maps ...
```
